_comment: Field dictionary for auto-generated retrieval glosses (contextual retrieval). Key = field name (matched by equality or `prefix_`), value = concept description + query-phrase synonyms. The gloss embedded for a fact = desc + location (collections) + value + synonyms; provenance is deliberately EXCLUDED from the embedded text (it blurs the vector).

_default.desc: Fact from the client's verified-facts bank

rent.desc: Monthly rent rate per square metre of an apartment
rent.syn: rent, rental rate, price per metre, monthly cost, how much rent

deposit.desc: Security deposit expressed as a multiple of the monthly rent
deposit.syn: deposit, security deposit, how many months deposit

units.desc: Number of residential units in the development
units.syn: apartments, units, flats, how many apartments, unit count

savings.desc: Cost saving achieved on the development (internal figure)

income_thresholds.syn: income thresholds, eligibility, income criteria, who qualifies

permit.syn: building permit, permit decision, planning approval, when was the permit issued

plot.syn: plot, parcel, land, plot number, where is it built

revenue.desc: Company revenue for a financial year
revenue.syn: revenue, turnover, sales, how much revenue
